messages:
maria: Quick sync — want to run a microtest for the latency/cost benchmark we use in launch posts + ads. thinking small, high-signal A/B across two chart styles. what do people think?
jason: +1. can we keep tests <72h and focused on 2 workloads (chat + embeddings)? low noise.
tess: Agreed. Also need two copy tracks: engineer-facing (numbers) and biz-facing (savings).
maria: Exactly. Chart A: p95 latency vs tokens/sec for 3 model configs. Chart B: tokens per $ (normalized to 1M tokens).
ben: For charts, prefer simple axes labels: "p95 latency (ms)" and "tokens / $ (k)". avoid log scales for socials.
kelly: For ad copy tests: A: "Same latency, lower cost" B: "Cut inference spend by X%" — we should guard claims. need accuracy.
jason: Can we run the microtest on real traffic-shaped inputs? i.e., sample prompt lengths: 32, 128, 512. that'll affect batching and kv cache.
tess: Good call. i'll pull token distribution from production traces and make a tiny workload generator.
maria: Routing ask: high-intent clicks -> book-a-demo form (sales-assisted). low-intent -> gated whitepaper + nurture. Suggestions for quick UTM paths?
ben: /book?src=bench_ad_high; /whitepaper?src=bench_ad_nurture. Also include a version param for creative: v=eng or v=biz.
kelly: For landing variants: Variant 1 shows the throughput chart front-and-center; Variant 2 shows tokens-per-dollar headline. test CTA wording too.
jason: Measurement: conversion rate (click->form submit), demo requests, and first-week MAU from demo leads. also engagement with bench dashboard (tracked via event).
tess: I'll produce two PNG export styles: one dense (table + chart) for docs, one simplified (bold numbers + single chart) for social.
maria: Can we include a tiny snippet in the copy that explains method? e.g.:
```
Methods: synthetic workload generated from Prod token distribution. models run on same HW; batching enabled. cost computed using on-demand GPU list prices.
```
ben: Good. let's add an asterisk and a link to the full benchmark doc in the landing.
kelly: Draft ad copies: 
- Eng: "Reduce inference cost without trading latency — see our benchmark."
- Biz: "Spend less on LLM inference. Keep responses fast."
I'll A/B these.
jason: Also think about lead routing automation: if form selects "SRE/Infra", tag as high-priority and route to solutions eng queue.
tess: tagging mapping: {"SRE/Infra":"solutions-eng", "Product":"growth-pm"} — i'll add to the form.
marketing-bot: webinar created: "Benchmark microtest demo" scheduled 2026-04-05 15:00 UTC — link: https://meet.example.com/bench-demo
maria: Nice. final asks: tess does charts + workload generator, kelly drafts copy, ben wires UTMs + landing variants, jason sets measurement, i'll coordinate creative approvals and claim wording. timeline: run microtest next Tue for 48 hours.
ben: noted. will whip up landing variants by EOD Fri.
kelly: draft copy pinging you all in #design for creative.
jason: i'll add the analytics events and a quick GA funnel.
tess: will post chart PNGs here when ready. expect first pass tomorrow. :rocket:
